scope: Manual review of all current paragraphs carrying a Yahoo Finance or US Treasury prior-close source tag, plus changed or retired prior-quote paths in the explicitly listed sealed editions: quoted market values and accompanying instrument, unit, direction, horizon and session/timing qualifiers. manual_review_notes: Quoted levels and percentage returns were compared with named own-date instruments; Treasury yield levels remain percentages while changes/spreads use basis points. Explicit1/5/20-session horizons and shorthand shared/respective horizons were read in their paragraph context.

All quoted DXY and Shanghai levels use index points after three confirmed Shanghai unit corrections. Vendor currency metadata was not used to denominate an index level. Other quoted stock/ETF, futures and FX units were checked against instrument identity.

Whole-prose signed-number scan found no missing unit on a signed decimal in the reviewed snapshots. DXY+USD candidates were valid multi-asset sentences whose dollar amounts belonged to other instruments, so these were diagnostic false positives.
March US ISM manufacturing49/services50.8 are described as index readings; percentage macro data in the same paragraphs were kept distinct. No percent PMI level error was found.
Apr4CoreWeave53.80USD/-12.32% is a valid available1-session observation. No fabricated5/20-session CRWV figure or suppressed CMCSA absolute price was found in the reviewed editions.

Holiday session tags were checked across US, European, Asian, Australian and cryptocurrency clocks. The last available FX observation on Apr21/22 is Apr17 in this source dataset; those dated levels were not silently assigned a later session.

Apr3tariff announcement, Apr16Nvidia disclosure, Apr18Netflix result, Apr23Tesla result, Apr24TexasInstruments/Chipotle/IBM results and Apr25Alphabet/Intel results retain the separation between earlier completed cash closes and later eligible news. Explicitly attributed headline event prices/percentages were not forced into the card return series.

Unmatched numeric diagnostic tokens were resolved as attributed own-headline facts (Newsmax>700%, gold>3100/3400, Tesla deliveries13% and profit71%/auto-revenue20%, Australia unemployment4.1%, Bitcoin90,000, Alphabet revenue12%), horizon wording, or pronoun/name aliases. They were not treated as quote arithmetic failures.

No frozen data, market cards or market-validation receipts were changed during prose review. Only the root-authorized Shanghai display-unit formatter fix was made to showcard.py.
